questions.q: Where does the Snowflake connector live in Power BI Desktop's Get Data dialog?
options: It requires a separate download outside of Get Data entirely
In a special 'Cloud Warehouses' category found nowhere else
Under the Database category, alongside connectors like Redshift and BigQuery
Under Online Services, not Database
questions.explain: Snowflake sits alphabetically among the other database connectors under the Database category — it isn't treated as a special case.

questions.q: What two fields does the initial Snowflake connection dialog require?
options: Server and Warehouse
Username and Password only
Database and Schema
Role and Table name
questions.explain: The connection dialog asks for the account's Server hostname and the compute Warehouse to run queries against — database/schema selection happens later in Navigator.

questions.q: Why does the lesson emphasize that the Warehouse field is 'a cost decision, not just a connection detail'?
options: Power BI charges its own separate fee based on warehouse name
The Warehouse field has no effect on billing at all
Warehouse selection only matters for storage cost, not compute
Whatever warehouse you enter is the one that burns credits every time this report queries or refreshes against Snowflake
questions.explain: The warehouse named in this dialog is the compute resource that runs every query the report issues, directly tying back to the credit-consumption concepts from Chapter 11.

questions.q: What authentication types does the Snowflake connector support in Power BI?
options: A one-time API key generated inside Power BI
Only Microsoft Entra ID, with no username/password option
Snowflake username/password and Microsoft Entra ID (including SSO where configured)
Only anonymous, credential-free access
questions.explain: The connector supports both native Snowflake username/password authentication and Microsoft Entra ID, with SSO available when configured on the Snowflake side.

questions.q: Where in this connection flow does the Import vs. DirectQuery choice happen?
options: It happens automatically and is never a manual choice
It's set only in Advanced options, before authentication
It's the very first thing selected, before entering a server name
At the very end of the flow, after Navigator, right before data loads
questions.explain: The Import/DirectQuery choice comes last in this dialog flow, after selecting objects in Navigator — and it's the entire subject of the next lesson.
